instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Set how people can find me in the Network, with the record to store", and give it subject (this person, the way the Network names them); records (the profile rows the caller read from its own store, each { id, type, value }); and the fields the ask needs.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, the tool id and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the answer: a profile row under keep is stored by the caller; a search names people by handle, never by contact.
